description: This file defines the LDAPUserCollection class, which encapsulates a collection of LDAP user objects, duplicates, and failed entries within an LDAP authentication plugin for OrangeHRM. It provides methods to access these data structures and a method to count total duplicate users.

classes.name: LDAPUserCollection
classes.description: Class that manages collections of LDAP users, including duplicates and failed entries, used within the LDAP authentication plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize LDAPUserCollection with LDAP users, duplicate usernames, users with duplicate usernames, and failed users.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Returns the array of LDAPUser objects mapped by username.

methods.name: getDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns the list of duplicate usernames.

methods.name: getUsersOfDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns a mapping of usernames to arrays of LDAPUser objects sharing the same username.

methods.name: getDuplicateUserCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of duplicate LDAP users.

methods.name: getFailedUsers
methods.description: Returns the array of failed user distinguished names (DNs).
